privacyBody: LG Electronics do Brasil processes your work identity, site, authentication, answers, progress, score and security records to administer Compliance Challenge 2026. Administrators access data according to their role and site. Rankings use masked identities. Scores serve an educational purpose and are not professional performance evaluations or disciplinary criteria. Records follow corporate retention policies. Questions and data requests: dpobr@lge.com.
privacyAck: By continuing, you acknowledge reading this notice, version 2026.1. This does not represent consent to data processing.

passwordPolicy: Use 12 to 128 characters with letters and numbers.
signupFailed: Unable to register. Check your authorized email with the administrator.

emailForRecovery: Enter the corporate email associated with your employee ID to recover your password.

recoveryExpired: The link did not create a valid session. Request another link and open it in the same browser.
activateHelp: Set your personal password. This individual link expires and can only be used once.
activationDone: Password created. Sign in with your employee ID or email and your new password.
activationFailed: Activation failed. The link may have expired or already been used. Try signing in if your password was created; otherwise, ask the administrator for a new link.
manualAccess: During this pilot, first access uses an individual link provided by the administrator. Email delivery is disabled. Contact the administrator for account recovery.
